agentProfiles.label: Codex CLI
agentProfiles.command: docker start taskdeck-agent-1 >/dev/null && docker exec -it -w /workspace taskdeck-agent-1 sh -lc 'TERM=xterm-256color codex'
agentProfiles.description: Run Codex CLI inside your configured agent container

agentProfiles.label: Goose
agentProfiles.command: docker start taskdeck-agent-1 >/dev/null && docker exec -it -w /workspace taskdeck-agent-1 goose
agentProfiles.description: Run Goose inside your configured agent container

agentProfiles.label: zsh
agentProfiles.command: docker start taskdeck-agent-1 >/dev/null && docker exec -it -w /workspace taskdeck-agent-1 sh -lc 'if command -v zsh >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec zsh; elif command -v bash >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec bash; else exec sh; fi'
agentProfiles.description: Open an interactive shell inside your configured agent container
